d: Action intensified on November 25, 2026, in the alleged harassment case involving a woman IAS officer in Tamil Nadu, as police served a summons on Kallakurichi TVK MLA C. Arul Vignesh and Investigating Officer Tiruppur SP Shristi Singh conducted a five-hour inquiry in Kallakurichi under the supervision of IGP N. Kamini. Following the Madras High Court's directions—after an FIR was registered on November 23 upon the officer's formal complaint—the Tamil Nadu government also notified an all-women Internal Complaints Committee under the POSH Act, chaired by senior IAS officer Kakarla Usha,…
